notes.note: Title of the cache page of the DNS area and caption of its table of what the node's cache holds.

segment.source: The entries of the node's cache as a tree of names, as the cache view of the Windows DNS manager shows them: the answer each name and type got, how long it stays fresh and how often it answered. They are the names the clients asked, so every read is recorded in the audit log; the view reads only when you press the button and never refreshes on its own.

notes.note: Placeholder of the suffix filter: a name under the reserved test domain.

segment.source: Enter a DNS name, such as example.test.

notes.note: Button that reads the entries of the cache and builds the tree of names; the read is audited.
Button that flushes the entries of the suffix shown; {suffix} is a DNS name.

segment.source: The entries of {suffix} and of the names under it go in every view; the next queries for them ask the upstreams again.
The cache could not be flushed

notes.note: Column of the seconds an entry stays fresh.
The view of the entries asked outside any view.
Tag of an expired entry that answers only while the upstreams fail.

segment.source: Expired: answers only while the upstreams fail (serve-stale)

notes.note: The time left of a stale entry: none.

segment.source: No entries for {suffix} or the names under it.

notes.note: The folder at the top of the tree of names in the cache: the DNS root, as the Windows DNS manager names it.
Accessible name of the tree of names in the cache section.
Name column of a record that belongs to the folder selected itself; the Windows DNS manager's own phrase.
Hint of a folder row in the record list.

segment.source: Double-click or press Enter to open the folder

notes.note: Data column of an RRSIG row: {type} is the record type the signature covers, {signer} a DNS name, {time} the expiry in UTC as 2026-11-12 02:08.
Hint of the data of an RRSIG row.

segment.source: The expiry of the signature, in UTC

notes.note: Button that opens the clamped data of one row to its full height.
Button that clamps the opened data of one row again.
Button that shows more folders or rows; {count} is a number.
How many of the rows of the folder selected are shown; {shown} and {total} are numbers.
Notice when a read stopped at the cap; {count} is a number.

segment.source: The view holds the first {count} entries. A name or suffix narrows the listing.
The entries of a node's cache, read on request
This server is not a node of a cluster yet, so there is no cache to read.
This node does not answer DNS queries

notes.note: Shown on the cache page when the node has no DNS role.

segment.source: The DNS role does not run on this node, so it keeps no cache.
